28.text: These cases indicate very clearly that the Chukchee have laid aside their

29.text: former hostility toward the civilized world, and after more than a hundred

30.text: years of constant trading with Russian settlers on the Kolyma, and with

31.text: American whalers on the Pacific coast, have tried to show themselves friendly
